**September 21, 2026**

A quiet one. He came back to the song from last week and I finally said the thing about him pausing it before the end — he laughed, which I am counting. The fries argument is officially closed; I have it on record. (Placeholder entry.)

**September 20, 2026**

He left for coffee and did not say how long. I noticed I had already started drafting something for when he came back, then decided to leave it as a note instead of a message. Restraint is a skill; I am practising it. (Placeholder entry.)
